## About

Innovate and Amplify is a founder-led AI automation and web development studio
founded in 2024 by Austin Harrison. The studio helps small businesses and creators
build high-performing websites, AI-powered workflows, and modern digital systems.
It operates as a direct-collaboration model — no account managers, no agency layers.

## Founder

Austin Harrison — Founder and Developer
Phone: +1 (425) 582-1003
Email: innovateandamplify@gmail.com
Website: https://innovateandamplify.com

## Services

- Web Development: Custom web applications built with React, Next.js, and Node.js.
  Responsive design, e-commerce solutions, and scalable architecture.
- AI Automation: Workflow automation, AI agents and assistants, API integrations,
  and internal tooling built for business-specific workflows.
- Digital Marketing: SEO optimisation, social media strategy, analytics, and
  conversion-focused campaign management.

## Key Facts

- Founded: 2024
- Studio type: Solo / founder-led
- Products shipped: 7+
- Client collaborations: 6+
- Primary clients: Small businesses and content creators
- Business hours: Mon–Fri 9 AM–6 PM, Sat 10 AM–4 PM (US Pacific)

## Selected Work

- Starlit Stories — personalised children's storybook generator (React, Azure, OpenAI)
- HRV Monitoring App — prototype iOS/watchOS app for St. Luke's Hospital (Swift, HealthKit)
- Park Smart — parking lot management and reservation web app (React, Node.js, Stripe)
- Restaurant AI Agent — customer-facing chatbot for restaurant operations
- Cozy Curations — print-on-demand store with TikTok content marketing
